name: Render Subtitles (Remotion)
description: Renders subtitle and motion graphics overlays to ProRes 4444 with alpha using Remotion. Takes the subtitle plan from step 4.01, generates Remotion input props via generate_subtitle_props.py, then runs npx remotion render to produce the final overlay video.

inputs.name: subtitle_plan
inputs.description: Subtitle groups with timestamps, text, and styling from step 4.01

inputs.name: audio_spine
inputs.description: Timed audio spine for total duration calculation

outputs.name: subtitle_overlay
outputs.description: Path to rendered ProRes 4444 overlay and metadata

preconditions: Remotion project is set up in remotion-subtitles/
postconditions: 'subtitle_overlay' is written to state with overlay_path
